//: Layer 3 cells. Each is one onboarding a new user might do. reset runs on the box over its shell tool before the driver starts; precheck must print OK or the run is blocked. Claude Code on the box loads the signed-in claude.ai account's connectors, so a clean cell turns them off with ENABLE_CLAUDEAI_MCP_SERVERS=false in ~/.bashrc.

reset: pkill -x claude >/dev/null 2>&1; pkill -x xfce4-terminal >/dev/null 2>&1; pkill -x chrome >/dev/null 2>&1; true
for s in user local project; do claude mcp remove box -s $s >/dev/null 2>&1; done; true
claude-code-landing.precheck: cd ~ && test -s ~/.claude/.credentials.json && grep -q '^export ENABLE_CLAUDEAI_MCP_SERVERS=false$' ~/.bashrc && ! ENABLE_CLAUDEAI_MCP_SERVERS=false claude mcp list 2>/dev/null | grep -q 'mcp.box.simular.ai' && echo OK
claude-code-landing.precheckHelp: Sign Claude Code in on the box once by hand (open a terminal on the box, run claude, finish /login). The run keeps that sign-in, turns off claude.ai connectors, and removes any local box MCP entry.
claude-code-landing.handover:
You use Claude Code in a terminal on this computer. You found box by Simular and the landing page told you to paste this into your agent:

  Set up box from https://box.simular.ai/install
claude-code-landing.task: Once box is set up, ask Claude Code to use box to take a screenshot of the box and describe what is on it.

claude-code-landing-connector.environment: claude.ai account already has the box connector
reset: pkill -x claude >/dev/null 2>&1; pkill -x xfce4-terminal >/dev/null 2>&1; pkill -x chrome >/dev/null 2>&1; true
for s in user local project; do claude mcp remove box -s $s >/dev/null 2>&1; done; true
claude-code-landing-connector.precheck: cd ~ && test -s ~/.claude/.credentials.json && claude mcp list 2>/dev/null | grep -q '^claude.ai .*mcp.box.simular.ai.*Connected' && echo OK
claude-code-landing-connector.precheckHelp: Sign Claude Code in on the box with a claude.ai account that has the box by Simular connector.
claude-code-landing-connector.handover:
You use Claude Code in a terminal on this computer. You found box by Simular and the landing page told you to paste this into your agent:

  Set up box from https://box.simular.ai/install
claude-code-landing-connector.task: Once box is set up, ask Claude Code to use box to take a screenshot of the box and describe what is on it.
